purpose: First bridge-retirement family: route four qualified Employee Core reads to D1 Native Core while preserving writes fail-closed and leaving remaining bridge actions unchanged.
invariants: Core OFF preserves exact current behavior.
Core READONLY routes only the four listed Core reads to /v1/employee/core.
Core writes are not enabled by Entry628.
Unknown/non-canary employees remain on their current Legacy behavior while Global Native Auth is OFF.
Bridge is not reduced in Production until Core runtime READONLY and native read smoke pass.
Ops remains GENERAL and Accounting remains READONLY.
